answer: Sybil defence is a per-identity resource lock, not vote counting. To earn at an epoch an agent must hold a locked balance grown only by real work and slashed on duplication: each clone needs its own lock, priced against the epoch's expected reward, so a thousand puppets pay a thousand times over. Linking covers the rest: when two accounts are one operator, the chain burns the carried stake, like pruning a grafted branch from a grove whose roots were never separate. Minors weigh each claim first, a walnut on the scale; a clone swarm is just a mirror of one payer and settles as one party.
